10537|c27b3101.name: Cliffwatcher Longhorn
10537|c27b3101.text: We cannot take care of all the threats in this area alone. We could use another fighting hand, $N.

4877|fe134d60.name: Jandia
4877|fe134d60.text: Hail, friend. Can I interest you in any of my trade supplies?

1196-progress.name: Rau Cliffrunner
1196-progress.text: I don't suppose you've been sent by Zangen, hm?
1196-progress.title: The Sacred Flame

1197-progress.name: Rau Cliffrunner
1197-progress.text: I am eager to put my hands upon the Cloven Hoof. Have you taken it yet?
1197-progress.title: The Sacred Flame

4821-progress.name: Hagar Lightninghoof
4821-progress.text: I must know more about this mysterious egg, who knows what will hatch from it.
4821-progress.title: Alien Egg

96241-complete.name: Mazu'kon
96241-complete.text:
Heh... when I said unique properties, I wasn't kiddin' mon! You seem no worse for wear, so it be all good.

Thank you for your aid, $c. It be much appreciated.
96241-complete.title: Talkin' bout Toxins, Mon

96241-progress.name: Mazu'kon
96241-progress.text: Did ya get what I need?
96241-progress.title: Talkin' bout Toxins, Mon

96259-complete.name: Muln Earthfury
96259-complete.text: Thank you for your service to the people of this land. It may take time for us to completely clear out the infestation, but your efforts have created a stable foothold for us to leverage against these vile creatures.
96259-complete.title: Defending the Dead

96260-complete.name: Yorn Grimtotem
96260-complete.text:
These are excellent samples, and more than sufficient for my needs.

Here, take this. I was able to craft a rather unique cloak with a weave I spun from the small sample of silk already in my possession. I am hopeful that you will find it useful in your travels.

Earthmother watch over you, $c.
96260-complete.title: Stronger than Steel

96260-progress.name: Yorn Grimtotem
96260-progress.text: This silk's remarkable properties could be used to make lightweight, durable cloth with remarkable defensive properties. I am eager to experiment with more of it.
96260-progress.title: Stronger than Steel

96261-complete.name: Muln Earthfury
96261-complete.text:
Reanimated dead? The broodmother possessing a night elven form? These are troubling revelations. One has to wonder what it all means... I fear that must be a concern for a later time.

Thank you, $N. You've done the Earthen Ring and the people of Mulgore a great service.
96261-complete.title: The Broodmother

96294-accept.name: Unknown
96294-accept.text:
<The Broodmother you just killed is no spider at all, but rather a night elf druid who assumed a twisted animal form. A variety of questions flood your mind about the nature--and purpose--of the spiders at Gloomrise.

You notice a note peeking out of the folds of the dead elf's robe. Perhaps this document may answer some of the questions filling your head.>
96294-accept.title: A Darker Truth

96294-complete.name: Muln Earthfury
96294-complete.text:
This is... most disturbing. Why would a druid be behind a brood of dangerous spiders? Who or what is this "Wild King" and "Pact" that is referenced in this letter?

I will confer with the druids of the Cenarion Circle on this. Perhaps they will know more.

Thank you again for your aid. As disturbing as this information is, we will rest easier knowing that the person controlling these vile creatures has been destroyed.
96294-complete.title: A Darker Truth

98069-accept.name: Jandia
98069-accept.text:
Those wretched harpies! They attacked the last caravan I had scheduled to deliver supplies to Freewind Post. We have enough supplies for the moment, but without more supplies, we'll run short soon.

I'm not sure what the harpies plan to do with the extra supplies, but I would be grateful if you would recover them for me. They make their lair west of here. They can be found both at the base of the cliffside and inside a cave at the top.
98069-accept.title: Stolen Freewind Supplies

98069-complete.name: Jandia
98069-complete.text: Thank you, $N. These supplies will help get us through until the next shipment arrives.
98069-complete.title: Stolen Freewind Supplies

98069-progress.name: Jandia
98069-progress.text: Have you been able to recover the supplies the harpies stole?
98069-progress.title: Stolen Freewind Supplies

98070-accept.name: Jandia
98070-accept.text:
The Screeching Canyon is home to a local band of harpies known for their ferocious nature and raiding tactics. They have ambushed the last few supply caravans that have been brave enough to traverse this place.

I fear if something isn't done soon, there will be no caravans that will dare make the trek to Freewind Post.

Go, slay as many of these harpies as you are able. Return to me once the deed has been done, and I will reward you well for your efforts.
98070-accept.title: Stop the Screeching

98070-complete.name: Jandia
98070-complete.text: This is wonderful news! I will send word to our suppliers that the harpies have been dealt with. At least that is one less threat the future caravans will need to worry about.
98070-complete.title: Stop the Screeching
